note: A strict build over register 1 (a register list keeps a strict build from needing a clean checkout) of two variables whose delivered names sit at the reader's 200-character search cap (ATCAP, 200) and one past it (OVERCAP, 201). The longer one is a located build error, so the strict build is blocked; the name at the cap is not refused.
fails_if: the over-cap check stops refusing a name longer than SEARCH_QUERY_MAX_CHARS (OVERCAP gets no `variable_name_over_search_cap` error, or only a warning, so the strict build completes), or counts the cap itself as over (ATCAP is refused too)

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers ATCAP and variable 6 OVERCAP in edition 99 (2020); their names are 200 and 201 characters.
